name: @arikchakma/mac-remote
description: Control your Mac's media from your phone over Wi-Fi: play/pause, seek, volume and fullscreen.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --minify --outfile=dist/cli.js && bun run build:keys
scripts.build:keys: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos12 src/keys.swift -o dist/keys-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos12 src/keys.swift -o dist/keys-x64 && lipo -create dist/keys-arm64 dist/keys-x64 -output dist/keys && rm dist/keys-arm64 dist/keys-x64
